display_name: 全部既有冻结架构：216个漏测模型补测与88份既有预测统一评分
description: 35批源训练304个E200模型，76个结构/精度组各4seed；216新预测及88原预测。固定clean测试，不按源表现筛掉模型。
authorization: 2026-10-03用户明确：要看测试集结果，而不是源域结果，之前没有进行测试的结果都要补测试。

code.note: Preparation baseline; actual committed release recorded after launch. Each row pins independently read original source commit.

data.representation: equalized=1; center256; unit packet RMS; fs=25000000Hz
data.tx_sets_ref: ManySig.tx_list: all6; actual physical class strings exported at runtime

permissions.query_use: All304 fixed predictions complete before one independent truth-last scorer; no fit or source reselection
permissions.claim_scope: User-authorized retrospective complete clean benchmark, historically exposed target; not blind confirmation or target-driven development

checkpoint.provenance_verdict: All304 source metadata independently read; per new worker original strict checkpoint_contract validates own scratch/full actual data and architecture/payload before query
checkpoint.selection_rule: All existing E200 models, all four model seeds; no source/target ranking or candidate filtering

execution.gpu_policy: One evaluator per idle GPU with>=12GB free; preserve all other processes
execution.stop_rule: Technical failure preserves row; continue other predictions; if any fail truth stays closed. No automatic retry or low-score stopping.

metrics_plan.primary: Complete test accuracy/Macro-F1/Macro-accuracy/confusion; all RX and TX; four-seed mean/SD; paired differences vs native/residual_fusion/relation_frequency_energy
metrics_plan.matrix: 304 models ×168000 physical queries;76 model/precision groups ×4seeds;clean only
metrics_plan.source_use: Only provenance/fixed E200; source scores are not final performance evidence
metrics_plan.later_test: No LEO; no target feedback or new architecture selection from this retrospective score
